title: Contraptions & Chaos
description: This Modpack contains mods like Create and some of it's Extensions as well as some Quality of Life and Optimization mods
body:
##  Contraptions & Chaos
A carefully curated **Create-focused** modpack built for engineering, trap architecture, and controlled chaos. Optimized for performance, packed with quality-of-life improvements, and ready for survival or creative building.

## What's Inside
- **Create & Addons:** Create, Create: Interiors, Create: New Age, Create: Ore Excavation, Create Jetpack
- ️ **Navigation & Info:** JEI, Xaero's Minimap
-  **Adventure:** The Bumblezone
-  **Optimization:** Performance mods tuned for smooth gameplay (low-end hardware tested)
-  **Visual Polish:** Fresh Animations, Fresh Moves, New Glowing Ores, Warden Girl, fem-zombies

##  Technical Details
- **Loader:** Fabric
- **Version:** 1.19.2
- **Environment:** Client & Server compatible
- **Optimized for:** Low-to-mid tier setups (ThinkPad L13 + KDE Plasma verified ✅)

##  Why Download?
Whether you're building intricate contraptions, automating factories, or just want a polished survival experience, this pack gives you the tools without the bloat. Expect traps, expect engineering, expect chaos. 

 *Stress-tested, performance-tuned, and ready for your next build.*
